description: Read one Skwirl note by its exact note_id from search_stash, recent_stash or list_stash_mentions. Returns stored Markdown including summary, next step, transcript and source permalink when available; a missing or inaccessible ID returns a no-match message. Each successful call increments the note's open counter, so repeated reads have an additional side effect. Use search_stash to find relevant notes, recent_stash to browse newest saves, or list_stash_mentions to find named entities before opening one. Usage examples: get_stash_note({"note_id":"a1b2c3d4e5f67890"}). Returns text.

note_id.description: Nonempty string ID returned by search_stash, recent_stash or list_stash_mentions; use it verbatim. Example: a1b2c3d4e5f67890.

name: get_stash_note
